profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer at Cox Automotive with 2 years of experience in Agile Scrum environments, building financial systems, specializing in payment processing and transaction optimization. Experienced in gathering requirements, writing user stories/ acceptance criteria, and collaborating with an Agile Team to deliver production-ready backend services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated within a cross-functional Agile Scrum team (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Analysts, Developers, QA) to deliver enhancements and fixes for financial service applications, while also participating in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives. Maintained banking features including batch and real-time processing, account ledger updates, and ACH/payment routing logic. Developed and optimized backend services using COBOL, interfacing with IMS and DB2 for high-volume data storage and retrieval. Wrote and clarified detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and system design documents to support feature development for more than 6 production-delivered features. Participated in code reviews, production deployments, and root cause analysis to ensure system stability and regulatory compliance.

projects.title: Fitness Tracker Website
projects.description:
Implemented a web application allowing users to track their fitness goals and compete with one
another using Node.js as a backend and React as the frontend. Designed a MySQL database schema as data storage for all user accounts and workout logs
